name: Ishizue Souta
source:
A classmate of the protagonist's at Chinju campus.
He is naturally attracted to other people, it doesn't matter if they are a boy or girl he's the type that has a lot of friends.
He has the power to see the souls of intelligent people as jewels.
If he desires, he can see the changes peoples emotions have on their souls.
